lostLinks.Title: Quotes will be deleted together with their links
lostLinks.Text: These quotes were removed from the list, and links to other quotes depend on them. The links will be deleted together with the quotes.

discard.Title: Quotes are not saved
discard.Text: The quote edits in the panel are not saved. Close the panel and lose them?

orphan.Title: Replacing the file — quotes will be deleted
orphan.Text: Quotes are bound to the content of the file — its pages, areas and seconds. After the replacement they have nothing to point to, so they are deleted together with the links that depended on them.

lostLinks.Title: Quotes will be deleted together with their links
lostLinks.Text: These quotes were removed from the text, and links to other quotes depend on them. The links will be deleted together with the quotes.

image.Title: This does not look like a picture
image.Type: The link in the picture field leads to a file of another type. The turn will show an error icon in its place.
image.Load: The link in the picture field did not open as a picture. The turn will show an error icon in its place.

video.Title: This does not look like a video
video.Type: The link in the video field leads to a file of another type. The player in the turn will not play it.
video.Load: The link in the video field did not open as a video. The player in the turn will not play it.

audio.Title: This does not look like audio
audio.Type: The link in the audio field leads to a file of another type. The player in the turn will not play it.
audio.Load: The link in the audio field did not open as audio. The player in the turn will not play it.

pdf.Title: This does not look like a PDF
pdf.Type: The link in the PDF field leads to a file of another type. The turn will show an error message in its place.
pdf.Load: The link in the PDF field did not open as a PDF. The turn will show an error message in its place.

format.Title: Format will remove the paragraph styling
format.Text: Format rejoins line breaks and extra spaces and leaves only the plain text of the paragraph. Quotes will disappear from the turn on save — together with the links that depended on them.
format.Count: To be removed: quotes {quotes}, hyperlinks {links}, bold or italic fragments {marked}.

accessExpired.Title: Access expired
accessExpired.Text: Your access to this game has expired. Go back to the lobby to enter the code again, or keep viewing the game as a visitor.

LobbyMoved.Title: The lobby has moved
LobbyMoved.Moved: The game lobby now has its own address. Your access codes to games are kept only in this browser, and the new lobby cannot see them by itself.
LobbyMoved.Export_hint: Download the file with your codes and upload it in the new lobby (Settings → Import). The codes stay in this browser until you clear the site data.
LobbyMoved.Games_count: Games with codes in this browser: {count}
LobbyMoved.Secret_warning: The file contains your access codes. They are secrets: anyone who has the file can enter your games. Do not publish it or pass it on.
LobbyMoved.Empty: There are no saved games in this browser, so there is nothing to move.
LobbyMoved.Clear_confirm: Access codes for {count, plural, one {# game} other {# games}}, game sign-ins and canvas settings will be removed from this browser. If you have not downloaded the file, the codes will be lost.
LobbyMoved.Clear_confirm_empty: Game sign-ins and canvas settings will be removed from this browser.
LobbyMoved.Clear_failed: The browser did not let the site data be removed.
